description:
take_next_fact_change (src/compiler2/scheduler.rs) finds the next change with a linear min_by over semantic_cmp and removes it with Vec::remove: 12,753 pops / 2.0M comparisons on one OptionParser.parse call, 25,060 / 6.1M on fixture 00761.

What the order is for: not correctness of the answer but reproducibility. It makes two compiles of one root run the same jobs in the same sequence; raw FIFO and LIFO both fail compiling_the_same_root_twice_runs_the_same_jobs_in_the_same_order. The order, including the tie rule (equal keys: newest first, reached on 134 of 12,753 pops; pinned by compiler2_scheduler_fact_frontier_preserves_newest_first_equal_key_chronology), must be kept exactly.

Change: the pending queue is a BinaryHeap whose entries compare by semantic_cmp on the key, then by a monotonically increasing arrival sequence where the later wins. The queue itself is the heap (the spike kept a Vec arrival buffer drained into a heap before each pop; do not keep both). Removes the min_by scan and Vec::remove. semantic_cmp is stable while keys sit in the queue (the queue lives inside one dispatch_changes call under &Ctx; 0 disagreements in 21.6M sampled re-checks on 00761). Coalescing duplicate entries is not part of this: 0.1% shrink, soundness not established. Does not touch quiescent_cone, settle_quiescent_fact or the Settled wake.

Measured (release, interp): comparisons 2,007,442 -> 57,329 (parse call), 6,142,711 -> 122,508 (00761); instructions -3.9% / -6.1% / -6.4% (parse call / 00761 / 00765). The full FactChange record of every pop is byte-identical to today's on four programs; lib 2114 passed, fz2_cli 38 passed, backend dumps identical. Not confirmed: two matrix::0076 run trials hit the 20 s limit at machine load ~100 and were not re-run on a base build.

Acceptance: pop log byte-identical to the base on the probe programs (keep the logging switch out of production; a test compares orders through telemetry or the existing same-order test); a work pin that comparisons per pop grow no faster than log of the queue; full gate.

Proposal page: /Users/j5n/Workspace/compile-cost-round-two.html (https://claude.ai/artifact/4T5Lime7pQxKbCiKJqaJ8x). Spike: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/s128/spike128.diff (base c768670cd), pop logs /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/s128/lg/. Related: fz-sc8.136 (the result differs under newest-first order).
title: The scheduler takes its next fact change without scanning the queue
